description: This file implements a service for image generation using OpenAI's DALL-E API within a project that integrates with other image processing components. It defines a class `OpenAIImageGenService` which manages API interactions, generates images from text prompts, and outputs image frames for further use.

classes.name: OpenAIImageGenService
classes.description: A service class for generating images using OpenAI's DALL-E API, supporting different image sizes and asynchronous operation.
